channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: ContractVille - Rent Expansion
item.description: Bring the real estate business to ContractVille with the Rent Expansion! Buy houses, decorate them with your furniture, and lease them to various tenants. Includes new property management mechanics to build your passive income.

item.title: Foolish Mortals
item.description: Louisiana, 1933. Thirty years ago an entire wedding suddenly & mysteriously vanished on the island of Devil's Rock, and with it went the location of the lost treasure of Bellemore Manor. To find it, you might need to die too. A cozy, story-driven, point & click adventure game of the merry & macabre.

item.title: Anomaly Company
item.description: You and your crew are sent in to assess reality in this 4-player co-op horror game. Memorize the environment. Spot disturbing anomalies. Decide if the timeline is safe. One bad call—and you’re forced to start over.

item.title: Bramble: The Mountain King
item.description: Bramble The Mountain King is a grim adventure set in a world inspired by dark, Nordic fables. Explore the beautiful yet dangerous and twisted land of Bramble in your endeavour to rescue your sister. Traverse a wondrous landscape and survive deadly encounters with Bramble's many hideous creatures.

item.title: ContractVille
item.description: Plan, design, build, and decorate your dream house in an open-world. Smash walls, sketch your layout, then build and decorate every inch—inside and garden. In an open world, tackle each renovation solo or with up to 4 friends. Pick up that hammer and start creating - Your dream house is waiting!

item.title: Heads Will Roll: Reforged
item.description: Hardcore survival RPG with non-linear story that lets you play as a young medieval soldier who over the course of battles and adventures becomes the most formidable and respected knight of his era. Or, if he’s not lucky enough, perishes in the chaos of the Hundred Years' War.

item.title: Monomyth
item.description: MONOMYTH is an immersive, first-person dungeon-crawling RPG inspired by the genre's late classics. Embark on a journey through a vast and highly interactive game world as you unravel the mysteries hidden beneath the ancient fortress of Lysandria.

item.title: Arcana Heart 3 LOVEMAX SIXSTARS!!!!!! XTEND
item.description: New playable character "Minori Amanohara" and new Arcana "Ichor" the Blood joins the battle in "Arcana Heart 3 LOVEMAX SIXSTARS!!!!!!"! More new characters to join in future updates!

item.title: Tentacle Locker 2
item.description: Play as a mischievous tentacle monster in a fun side scroller. Hide in lockers, jump out at the right time, catch unsuspecting students to earn money, and unlock silly cosmetic upgrades. Cause playful chaos everywhere! (This version includes new areas and outfits.)
